[[File:TCGMix website logo.jpg|thumb|210px|TCGMix logo.]]
'''TCGMix''' is a fan-run website for playing card games in a web browser. Its playtests include a prototype for [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars CCG]]. Players can browse the Star Wars card archive and public decks before signing in.<ref name="home" /><ref name="starwars" />

== Star Wars CCG prototype ==

[[File:TCGMix SWCCG gameplay - 7 November 2026.png|thumb|340px|A Star Wars CCG bot game on TCGMix, 7 November 2026.]]
The [https://tcgmix.com/starwars/ Star Wars CCG prototype] supports bot games and rooms for head-to-head play. Players sign in to play or save decks.<ref name="starwars" /> [[Lex]]'s 11 October 2026 development update described support for custom decks and a card pool based on ''Premiere''.<ref name="lex-swccg" />

== History and community ==

[[File:TCGMix homepage - 7 November 2026.png|thumb|TCGMix homepage.]]
Lex announced the TCGMix hub in its Discord on 2 October 2026.<ref name="lex-hub" /> At the time, the homepage featured ''Young Jedi'', ''Stargate'' and ''Harry Potter''. Kawoosh Online and Diagon Duels used separate accounts for ''Stargate'' and ''Harry Potter'', respectively.<ref name="october" /> Lex shared details of the site's game plugins in a 10 October playtest update.<ref name="lex-playtests" />

TCGMix is free to play. The site uses credits earned in games for its shop and awards cards and progress rewards through play.<ref name="home" />

== Game catalog ==

TCGMix groups its games into featured titles and playtests. The featured list includes Kawoosh Online and Diagon Duels, which have their own websites.<ref name="home" /><ref name="playtests" />
